title: Famous religious buildings and their country

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) WHERE { VALUES ?class { wd:Q16970 wd:Q32815 wd:Q34627 wd:Q44613 wd:Q160742 wd:Q1370598 wd:Q2977 } ?item wdt:P31 ?class ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 20) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

country.match: Match each religious building to its country.
country.odd: Three of these religious buildings are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Hagia Sophia
rows.description: mosque, museum, and former church in Istanbul, Turkey
rows.hook: began as a Christian cathedral, later became a mosque, then a museum, then a mosque again

rows.label: Florence Cathedral
rows.hook: is topped by Brunelleschi's enormous red-tiled dome

rows.label: Al-Masjid Al-Haram
rows.description: Islam's holiest mosque in Mecca, Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: surrounds the Kaaba, the cube-shaped focus of the Hajj pilgrimage

rows.label: Milan Cathedral
rows.hook: is a vast marble building bristling with spires, among the largest in Europe

rows.label: Sacré-Cœur
rows.description: Roman Catholic church in Paris, France
rows.hook: gleams white atop the Montmartre hill with a Romano-Byzantine dome

rows.label: Sultan Ahmed Mosque
rows.description: historic mosque located in Istanbul, Turkey, also known as Blue Mosque
rows.hook: is nicknamed for the blue tiles lining its interior and has six minarets

rows.label: Saint Catherine Monastery
rows.description: Greek Orthodox monastery (the oldest) at the foot of Mount Sinai, Egypt
rows.hook: sits at the foot of the mountain where Moses is said to have received the commandments

rows.label: Ulm Minster
rows.hook: has the tallest church steeple in the world

rows.label: York Minster
rows.description: cathedral of York, North Yorkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is a huge Gothic cathedral famed for its medieval stained glass and Great East Window

rows.label: Nidaros Cathedral
rows.hook: is the northernmost medieval church of its kind, built over the grave of a Viking king-saint

rows.label: St Mark's Basilica
rows.hook: is covered in glittering gold mosaics beside the Doge's Palace

rows.label: Umayyad Mosque
rows.hook: houses a shrine said to hold the head of John the Baptist

rows.label: Charminar
rows.hook: is an old-city landmark with four tall minarets, near a famous bangle market

rows.label: Hallgrímskirkja
rows.hook: has a striking concrete tower inspired by basalt lava columns
